issues.description: changedFiles path comparison lacks a stated normalization invariant and may silently filter everything
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but VitestGit.findChangedFiles and config.related are not guaranteed to return paths in the same shape (slashes, absolute vs relative, query strings). On Windows or with mixed separators the membership test silently returns false for every file. Normalize at the boundary in onTestRunStart and document the invariant.

issues.description: globCache key omits changedFiles, so cached verdicts can be poisoned by ordering
issues.detail: The cache stores include/exclude results keyed on filename alone, but the answer now also depends on this.changedFiles. onTestRunStart clears the cache, but any isIncluded call before that hook fires (config resolution, plugin setup, prewarm) caches an unfiltered verdict that survives. Either key on (filename, changedFiles identity) or separate the pure glob match from the changed-file filter.

issues.description: findChangedFiles null result silently disables the filter and reports all files
issues.detail: When VitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (not a git repo, bad ref) onTestRunStart assigns undefined and isIncluded falls through to include everything. The user asked for changed-only coverage and gets full coverage with no warning. No test exercises this branch. Warn or throw on the null path instead of silently degrading the postcondition.

issues.description: Wrong data structure: O(n) array membership test on per-file hot path
issues.detail: changedFiles is a string[] and isIncluded runs this.changedFiles.includes(filename) once per source file, yielding O(F x C) on cold runs and getUntestedFiles walks. Build a Set<string> once in onTestRunStart for O(1) lookup; the cache-invalidation story is unchanged.

issues.description: onTestRunStart wired into three duplicate call sites in core.ts inviting future drift
issues.detail: core.ts now invokes await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() after _testRun.start at three places with no shared helper. The 'every run-start notifies coverage' invariant is carried by convention; a fourth code path will forget it. Fold the call into _testRun.start or a private helper so the invariant is enforced by reading one function.

issues.description: CLI transform handles boolean inputs the CLI parser never produces and accepts ambiguous refs
issues.detail: The transform special-cases value === true/false (unreachable from string CLI args) and coerces 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' to booleans, silently shadowing any git ref literally named those. Narrow the transform's input type to string, document the precedence rule, and either remove the dead boolean branches or state why they are reachable.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK around the changed-files filtering layer. Three reinforcing correctness issues dominate: path normalization between VitestGit/config.related output and isIncluded's slash+cleanUrl form is unspecified and likely breaks on Windows; the globCache key omits changedFiles so any pre-hook call poisons it; and a null findChangedFiles result silently degrades to reporting all files instead of failing loud. Secondary concerns are a wrong data structure (array membership on a per-file hot path), three duplicated onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts that will rot, and a CLI transform with dead boolean branches and ambiguous string-to-bool coercion. The happy path is solid; the failure paths and invariants need to be written down and enforced before this lands.
